arXiv:2605.23871v1 [stat.ML] 2026 年 5 月 22 日arXiv:2605.23871v1 [stat.ML] 22 May 2026

继续 Muon：Muon 优化器的哈密顿概率梯度流视角Move on Muon : A Hamiltonian probability gradient flow perspective of Muon optimizer

Aratrika Mustafi∗ Soumya Mukherjee and Bharath K. Sriperumbudur
摘要Abstract

我们在由正则化 Muon（理想化 Muon 优化器的分析平滑版本）引起的矩阵值参数上定义的概率测量空间上开发了梯度流。关键的观察结果是，正则化正交化图是核范数的平滑 Fenchel 对偶平滑的梯度。这将（正则化）Muon 更新标识为更新变量中的镜像/近似步骤，动量充当双坐标。我们使用这种结构将 Muon 从单个矩阵参数提升到以下形式的有限粒子概率目标We develop a gradient flow on the space of probability measures defined on matrix-valued parameters induced by regularized Muon, an analytically smoothed version of the idealized Muon optimizer. The key observation is that the regularized orthogonalization map is the gradient of a smooth Fenchel-dual smoothing of the nuclear norm. This identifies the (regularized) Muon update as a mirror/prox step in the update variable, with momentum acting as the dual coordinate. We use this structure to lift Muon from a single matrix parameter to finite-particle probability objectives of the formJ​(ρ)=R​(∫F​𝑑ρ)J(\rho)=R\left(\int Fd\rho\right)，由神经网络训练的平均场描述激发的设置，并推导惯性连续时间限制。使用这种结构，我们推导了步长和动量惯性缩放下的有限粒子连续时间极限，然后通过参数动量对的概率定律传递到相空间平均场方程。由此产生的流动可以被证明是阻尼哈密顿概率动力学，其动能由正则化 μ 介子镜势引起。我们证明了精确的哈密顿耗散恒等式，表明哈密顿能量单调递减。虽然目标目标本身不必沿惯性 μ 子动力学是单调的，但在额外的梯度主导、有界动量和曲率/对齐假设下，我们获得了目标间隙的连续和离散时间指数收敛率。我们还研究了平均场极限方程的适定性，并为相互作用的粒子系统建立了混沌传播保证。最后，我们将公式扩展到乘积矩阵空间上的希尔伯特值特征图，产生适用于平滑变压器专家混合模型的块式 Muon 概率流。, a setting motivated by mean-field descriptions of neural-network training, and derive the inertial continuous-time limit. Using this structure, we derive the finite-particle continuous-time limit under the inertial scaling of step size and momentum, and then pass to a phase-space mean-field equation over probability laws on parameter-momentum pairs. The resulting flow can be shown to be a damped Hamiltonian probability dynamics whose kinetic energy is induced by the regularized Muon mirror potential. We prove an exact Hamiltonian dissipation identity, showing that the Hamiltonian energy decreases monotonically. While the target objective itself need not be monotone along the inertial Muon dynamics, under additional gradient-dominance, bounded-momentum, and curvature/alignment assumptions, we obtain continuous and discrete-time exponential convergence rates for the objective gap. We also study the well-posedness of the mean-field limit equation and establish propagation of chaos guarantees for the interacting particle system. Finally, we extend the formulation to Hilbert-valued feature maps on product matrix spaces, yielding a blockwise Muon probability flow applicable to smooth transformer mixture-of-experts models.

1 简介Introduction

深度神经网络的优化方法通常会成功，因为它们利用了参数标量坐标视图中不可见的结构。随着模型尺寸的增长和参数块变得高度结构化，优化器施加的几何形状可以极大地影响稳定性和速度。这对于矩阵值参数尤其明显，其中标准梯度方法使用的 Frobenius 几何只是一种可能的选择。 标准一阶优化器（例如 SGD、Adam 及其变体）主要通过坐标欧几里得更新来处理这些参数。虽然这在实践中非常有效，但最近的工作表明，矩阵几何可以在优化中发挥更明确的作用，特别是当更新方向根据光谱信息进行约束或归一化时。Optimization methods for deep neural networks often succeed because they exploit structure that is not visible in the scalar-coordinate view of the parameters. As model sizes grow and parameter blocks become highly structured, the geometry imposed by the optimizer can substantially influence both stability and speed. This is particularly visible for matrix-valued parameters, where the Frobenius geometry used by standard gradient methods is only one possible choice. Standard first-order optimizers such as SGD, Adam, and their variants treat these parameters largely through coordinatewise Euclidean updates. While this has been extremely effective in practice, recent work has shown that matrix geometry can play a more explicit role in optimization, particularly when the update direction is constrained or normalized according to spectral information.

Muon 优化器由The Muon optimizer introduced byJordan et al. (2024)是这种矩阵几何观点的一个最近且有影响力的例子。在较高层面上，Muon 为每个矩阵参数维护一个动量变量，并以该动量方向的正交化版本更新该参数。实证研究表明，这种正交矩阵更新在语言模型训练中具有竞争力，并且最近的大规模实施已经研究了通过适当的缩放、权重衰减和实施选择，Muon 在 LLM 训练中的实用程度is a recent and influential example of this matrix-geometric viewpoint. At a high level, Muon maintains a momentum variable for each matrix parameter and updates the parameter in an orthogonalized version of that momentum direction. Empirical studies have shown that such orthogonalized matrix updates can be competitive in language-model training, and recent large-scale implementations have investigated the extent to which Muon can be made practical for LLM training through suitable scaling, weight decay, and implementation choices(Liu et al., 2025)。 在理想化形式中，如本文所考虑，正交化映射保留动量矩阵的奇异向量，并将其非零奇异值替换为 1。因此，μ子不是直接沿原始动量方向移动，而是沿极因子方向移动。此操作使得更新对奇异值的尺度不敏感，但对其奇异子空间高度敏感。实际实现以数值方式近似这种正交化，例如使用牛顿-舒尔茨迭代，但精确的极因子图捕获了该方法的中心几何机制。. In the idealized form, as considered in this paper, the orthogonalization map keeps the singular vectors of the momentum matrix and replaces its nonzero singular values by one. Thus, rather than moving directly in the raw momentum direction, Muon moves in a polar-factor direction. This operation makes the update insensitive to the scale of the singular values but highly sensitive to their singular subspaces. Practical implementations approximate this orthogonalization numerically, for instance using Newton-Schulz iterations, but the exact polar-factor map captures the central geometric mechanism of the method.

这些发展引发了一个理论问题：These developments motivate a theoretical question :哪些连续时间和概率空间动力学与更新方向由谱正交化产生的动量优化器自然相关？What continuous-time and probability-space dynamics are naturally associated with a momentum optimizer whose update direction is produced by spectral orthogonalization?

凸几何已经提出了第一个答案。极因子方向不是任意归一化：它是谱范数单位球上的最陡下降方向。等价地，理想的 Muon 步骤解决了算子范数约束下的线性最小化问题。这一观点在最近关于梯度正交化和范数约束线性最小化预言的非欧几里得信赖域解释的工作中得到了发展。A first answer is already suggested by convex geometry. The polar-factor direction is not an arbitrary normalization: it is a steepest descent direction over a spectral-norm unit ball. Equivalently, the ideal Muon step solves a linear minimization problem under an operator-norm constraint. This perspective has been developed in recent work on non-Euclidean trust-region interpretations of gradient orthogonalization and norm-constrained linear minimization oracles(Kovalev, 2025; Pethick et al., 2025)。相关观点还将 Muon 型方法与隐式光谱约束和更广泛的光谱优化器系列联系起来. Related viewpoints also connect Muon-type methods to implicit spectral constraints and broader families of spectral optimizers(Chen et al., 2025a).

本文从现有的观察出发，但采取了不同的路线。 我们以硬 Mu 子的谱范数信赖域解释为起点，并从中发展出动量 Mu 子的概率梯度流视角。This paper starts from this existing observation but takes a different route. We take the spectral-norm trust-region interpretation of hard Muon as a starting point and develop from it a probabilistic gradient-flow perspective on Muon with momentum.

The regularized Muon update then becomes a genuine mirror/prox step in the update or velocity variable, with the momentum serving as the corresponding dual coordinate. 本文的第二个目标是将这种镜像解释从单个矩阵更新提升为概率空间描述。我们考虑形式的泛函The second goal of the paper is to lift this mirror interpretation from a single matrix update to a probability-space description. We consider functionals of the form

这包括从经验测量中获得的有限粒子目标，并且还为研究参数群体提供了方便的平均场视角。对于一个This includes finite-particle objectives obtained from empirical measures, and it also provides a convenient mean-field perspective for studying populations of parameters. Under the inertial scaling of step-sizes, the discrete dynamics converge to finite-particle ODEs, leading to a McKean-Vlasov continuity equation forμt=Law​(Wt,Pt)\mu_{t}=\mathrm{Law}(W_{t},P_{t})。 生成的概率流具有阻尼哈密顿流结构，而不是普通的 Wasserstein 梯度流。哈密顿流形式主义已在文献中用于研究概率测度空间上基于动量的加速. The resulting probability flow has a damped Hamiltonian flow structure, instead of being an ordinary Wasserstein gradient flow. Hamiltonian-flow formalisms have been used in literature to study momentum-based acceleration on the space of probability measures(Wang and Li, 2022; Chen et al., 2025b)。在我们的设置中，哈密顿结构是特定于 Muon 的，并且是由与正则化核范数平滑相关的镜像映射引起的。 由此产生的流满足精确的哈密顿耗散恒等式，这阐明了为什么目标. In our setting, the Hamiltonian structure is specific to Muon and is induced by the mirror map associated with regularized nuclear-norm smoothing. The resulting flow satisfies an exact Hamiltonian dissipation identity, which clarifies why the objectiveJJ本身不需要单调递减。与其他惯性或加速系统一样，能量可以在目标变量和动量变量之间移动，而总阻尼哈密顿量会减小。最近的工作itself need not decrease monotonically. As in other inertial or accelerated systems, energy can move between the objective and the momentum variable, while the total damped Hamiltonian decreases. Recent workPeyré (2026)考虑谱 Wasserstein 流，其 ODE 极限对应于具有额外核范数缩放的无动量 Muon 更新。我们的哈密顿概率流公式更接近于实践中广泛实施的 Muon 版本，因为它保留了动量变量，将动量视为平滑镜像映射的双坐标，并将硬极 Muon 更新恢复为considers specral Wasserstein flow whose ODE limit corresponds to a momentum-free Muon update with an extra nuclear norm scaling. Our Hamiltonian probability-flow formulation is closer to the version of Muon largely implemented in practice since it preserves the momentum variable, treats momentum as the dual coordinate of a smooth mirror map, and recovers the hard polar Muon update asε↓0\varepsilon\downarrow 0.

然后，我们将公式从单个矩阵空间扩展到矩阵块的有限乘积空间。这允许相同的镜像几何形状作用于结构化模型的所有块。这对于参数由多个矩阵组成的神经网络层非常重要，特别是对于同时具有专家参数和路由器参数的专家混合模型。在扩展的产品空间中We then extend the formulation from a single matrix space to finite product spaces of matrix blocks. This allows the same mirror geometry to act on all blocks of structured models. This is important for neural network layers whose parameters consist of several matrices, and especially for mixture-of-experts models with both expert and router parameters. In the extended product spaceΘ\Theta，正则化 Muon 势是块可分离的，对应的正交化（镜像）图, the regularized Muon potential is block-separable, and the corresponding orthogonalization (mirror) mapOrthεΘ\operatorname{Orth}_{\varepsilon}^{\Theta}以可分离的方式将谱正则化应用于每个矩阵块。这给出了产品空间镜像步骤、产品空间哈密顿量以及相应的耗散恒等式。这种对产品空间的概括使我们能够分析等权重的专家混合物，其中每个专家模型都是神经网络或变压器，以及此类专家混合物的平滑路由/选择变体。对于变压器专家混合模型，依赖于输入的路由在希尔伯特值特征映射内进行编码applies the spectral regularization to each matrix block in a separable manner. This gives a product-space mirror step, a product-space Hamiltonian, and a corresponding dissipation identity. This generalization to product spaces allows us to analyze equally weighted mixture-of-experts where each expert model is a neural network or a transformer, as well as smooth-routing/selection variants of such mixture-of-experts. For transformer mixture-of-experts models, input-dependent routing is encoded inside the Hilbert-valued feature mapFF。平滑的非标准化门和 softmax 标准化门直接适合框架，而精确的硬顶门. Smooth unnormalized gates and softmax-normalized gates fit directly into the framework, while exact hard top-kk路由位于平滑理论之外，可以被视为非平滑极限情况。这种区别与稀疏专家混合路由和噪声路由器平滑的先前工作一致，强调稀疏路由的不连续性以及噪声或软化路由器的平滑效果routing lies outside the smooth theory and can be treated as a nonsmooth limiting case. This distinction is consistent with prior work on sparse mixture-of-experts routing and noisy router smoothing, emphasizing the discontinuity of sparse routing and the smoothing effect of noisy or softened routers(Shazeer et al., 2017; Fedus et al., 2022; Chen et al., 2022; Vaswani et al., 2017).

2 μ介子作为镜子正则化 信赖域步骤Muon as a mirror regularized trust-region step

This reformulation interprets the orthogonalization step in the Muon update as the solution to a variational problem on matrix space. The resulting variational structure then enables the development of a Hamiltonian formulation of the Muon dynamics in later sections.

备注1Remark 1 （为什么正则化很重要）(Why regularization matters).

硬的The hardmap⁡P↦Orth⁡(P)\operatorname{map}P\mapsto\operatorname{Orth}(P)是选定的元素is a selected element of∂‖P‖nuc \partial\|P\|_{\text{nuc }}并且在秩不足动量处设定值。上面的平滑族保留了光谱信任区域几何形状，同时给出了单值 Lipschitz 向量场。这是使 ODE、PDE 和混沌传播论证成为标准而不是微分包含论证的要素。and is set-valued at rank-deficient momenta. The smooth family above preserves the spectral trust-region geometry while giving a single-valued Lipschitz vector field. This is the ingredient that makes the ODE, PDE, and propagation-of-chaos arguments standard rather than differential-inclusion arguments.

同一更新的三个等效视图Three equivalent views of the same update。为了以后的使用，并行地保持三种解释是有帮助的。困难的步骤是谱信任区域最速下降方向。非光滑镜像形式表示相同的步骤是由光谱单位球的指示符生成的，其共轭是核范数。正则化步骤表明 Muon 是光滑镜族的零温度极限。这些不是相互竞争的描述：信赖域视图解释了几何形状，镜像视图提供了变分更新，平滑的 Fenchel 对提供了连续时间和平均场限制所需的分析正则性。. For later use it is helpful to keep three interpretations in parallel. The hard step is a spectral trust-region steepest descent direction. The nonsmooth mirror form says that the same step is generated by the indicator of the spectral unit ball, whose conjugate is the nuclear norm. The regularized step says that Muon is the zero-temperature limit of a smooth mirror family. These are not competing descriptions: the trust-region view explains the geometry, the mirror view provides the variational update, and the smooth Fenchel pair provides the analytic regularity needed for continuous-time and mean-field limits.

The construction above preserves the spectral unit-ball domain and only smooths the singular-value saturation. Consequently, the limitε↓0\varepsilon\downarrow 0返回规范极坐标因子方向而不是欧几里德最速下降方向。这就是正则化与芬切尔对相关联而不是作为通用数值平滑引入的原因。returns the canonical polar-factor direction rather than a Euclidean steepest-descent direction. This is the reason the regularization is tied to a Fenchel pair rather than introduced as a generic numerical smoothing.

The second experiment is a nonlinear teacher-student problem on a product matrix space with each particleθi=(Ai,Bi)∈Θ=ℝp×r×ℝr×d\theta_{i}=(A_{i},B_{i})\in\Theta=\mathbb{R}^{p\times r}\times\mathbb{R}^{r\times d}与with the(M,N)(M,N)-粒子师生tanh神经网络目标-particle teacher-student tanh neural network objectiveJN​((Ai,Bi)i=1N)=12​S​p​∑s=1S‖1N​∑i=1NAi​tanh⁡(Bi​xsd)−ys‖22J_{N}((A_{i},B_{i})_{i=1}^{N})=\frac{1}{2Sp}\sum_{s=1}^{S}\left\|\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}A_{i}\tanh\!\left(\frac{B_{i}x_{s}}{\sqrt{d}}\right)-y_{s}\right\|_{2}^{2}受训于trained onSS输入输出input-output(xs,ys)(x_{s},y_{s})对。在这两种情况下pairs. In both casesJ∗=0J^{*}=0是可以实现的。部分实验结果如图所示is attainable. The experimental results are reported in part in Figure1，完整的数值实验在附录中讨论。综合实验支持论文中提出的哈密顿解释。在矩阵均值匹配问题中，正则化 Muon 避免了硬极坐标更新和牛顿舒尔茨更新所表现出的有限步剩余下限，从而允许目标能量和哈密顿能量平滑地衰减到零。在非线性乘积空间神经网络设置中，正则化动力学保留了谱 Muon 几何的优点，同时表现出光滑镜公式预测的稳定性。, with the complete numerical experiments being discussed in the Appendix. The synthetic experiments support the Hamiltonian interpretation developed in the paper. In the matrix mean-matching problem, regularized Muon avoids the finite-step residual floor exhibited by hard polar and Newton-Schulz updates, allowing the objective and Hamiltonian energies to decay smoothly towards zero. In the nonlinear product-space neural network setting, the regularized dynamics preserve the advantages of spectral Muon geometry while exhibiting the stability predicted by the smooth mirror formulation.

8 结论Conclusion

这项工作将 Muon 确定为一种光谱信赖域镜像方法，并推导了由其正则化正交化图引起的阻尼哈密顿概率流。它表明 Muon 的矩阵级更新承认相干变分、平均场和李亚普诺夫结构。This work identifies Muon as a spectral trust-region mirror method and derives the damped Hamiltonian probability flow induced by its regularized orthogonalization map. It shows that Muon’s matrix-level update admits a coherent variational, mean-field, and Lyapunov structure.

A.10 产品空间上的希尔伯特值概率泛函Hilbert-valued probability functionals on product spaces

标量The scalarFF主要论文中的输出理论基于单个矩阵空间上的概率分布。特别是，单隐藏层神经网络教师-学生平均场和变压器专家混合设置分别需要参数元组和专家路由器参数元组的概率分布。因此，在引入变分和动力学结构之前，参数空间被扩大。-output theory in the main paper is based on a probability distribution over a single matrix space. In particular, the one-hidden layer neural network teacher-student mean-field and the transformer mixture-of-experts setting requires a probability distribution over parameter tuples and an expert-router parameter tuple, respectively. The parameter space is therefore enlarged before the variational and dynamical constructions are introduced.

A.10.1 扩展产品参数空间Extended product parameter space

让Let

Θ=Θexp×Θgate=∏b=1Bℝmb×nb\Theta=\Theta_{\mathrm{exp}}\times\Theta_{\mathrm{gate}}=\prod_{b=1}^{B}\mathbb{R}^{m_{b}\times n_{b}} (23)

是有限维实希尔伯特空间。第一个be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space. The firstBexpB_{\mathrm{exp}}块可以代表专家参数，而其余的blocks may represent expert parameters, while the remainingBgate=B−BexpB_{\mathrm{gate}}=B-B_{\mathrm{exp}}块代表路由器或门控参数。通用点可写为blocks represent router or gating parameters. A generic point is written as

θ=(ω,ϕ)=(θ(1),…,θ(B)),\theta=(\omega,\phi)=\left(\theta^{(1)},\ldots,\theta^{(B)}\right), (24)

哪里whereω∈Θexp\omega\in\Theta_{\mathrm{exp}}和andϕ∈Θgate\phi\in\Theta_{\mathrm{gate}}。希尔伯特内积的乘积是. The product Hilbert inner product is

⟨θ,ϑ⟩Θ≔∑b=1B⟨θ(b),ϑ(b)⟩F,‖θ‖Θ2≔∑b=1B‖θ(b)‖F2.\left\langle\theta,\vartheta\right\rangle_{\Theta}\coloneqq\sum_{b=1}^{B}\left\langle\theta^{(b)},\vartheta^{(b)}\right\rangle_{F},\qquad\left\|\theta\right\|_{\Theta}^{2}\coloneqq\sum_{b=1}^{B}\left\|\theta^{(b)}\right\|_{F}^{2}. (25)

下面的 Wasserstein 空间是根据以下度量构建的The Wasserstein spaces below are built from the metric induced by∥⋅∥Θ\left\|\cdot\right\|_{\Theta}。路由参数是状态变量的一部分。因此，任何力场、动量变量、镜像映射和哈密顿梯度都定义在同一扩展空间上. The routing parameter is part of the state variable. Consequently, any force field, momentum variable, mirror map, and Hamiltonian gradient is defined on the same extended spaceΘ\Theta不仅在专家子空间上。and not only on the expert subspace.

矢量值和标量路由器参数可以包含在 (Vector-valued and scalar router parameters can be included in (23）将向量视为一列矩阵，将标量视为) by treating vectors as one-column matrices and scalars as1×11\times 1矩阵。通过将齐次坐标附加到输入表示，也可以将偏差吸收到矩阵块中。因此，乘积矩阵公式涵盖了通常的仿射路由器分数，而无需引入单独的符号。matrices. Biases may also be absorbed into matrix blocks by appending a homogeneous coordinate to the input representation. Thus the product matrix formulation covers the usual affine router scores without introducing a separate notation.

A.10.3 规律性假设Regularity assumptions

平滑 ODE 和 PDE 理论可以在全局假设或局部有限范围假设下表述。局部版本是 Transformer 模型的自然版本，因为注意力、前馈和路由器得分图在有界参数集上是平滑的，而所有参数空间上的全局 Lipschitz 常量通常不可用。The smooth ODE and PDE theory can be stated under either global assumptions or localized finite-horizon assumptions. The localized version is the natural one for transformer models, because attention, feed-forward, and router score maps are smooth on bounded parameter sets, while global Lipschitz constants on all of parameter space are generally unavailable.

A.11 扩展乘积空间上的正则化 Muon 镜几何结构Regularized Muon mirror geometry on the extended product space

正则化 Muon 镜像映射在全乘积空间上定义The regularized Muon mirror map is defined on the full product spaceΘ\Theta，包括专家块和路由器块。该结构是块可分离的，因此 Fenchel 共轭和镜像更新解释继承自单矩阵光谱结构。, including both expert and router blocks. A.20.5 硬顶-Hard top-kk路由和噪声路由routing and noisy routing

精确的硬顶-Exact hard top-kk或者交换机路由使用选择最大路由器分数的不连续映射。上面的光滑常微分方程、哈密顿量、曲率和混沌传播定理没有涵盖该图。有两种数学上一致的方法可以将硬路由与现有理论联系起来。or switch routing uses the discontinuous map that selects the largest router scores. This map is not covered by the smooth ODE, Hamiltonian, curvature, and propagation-of-chaos theorems above. There are two mathematically consistent ways to connect hard routing to the present theory.

首先，硬路由可以用平滑松弛代替，例如带有温度的 softmax、Gumbel-softmax 或可微分的预期路由器。在 Gumbel-max 情况下，预期的 top-1 选择概率正是 softmax 概率，因此增强特征 (First, hard routing can be replaced by a smooth relaxation, such as softmax with temperature, Gumbel-softmax, or a differentiable expected router. In the Gumbel-max case, the expected top-1 selection probabilities are precisely softmax probabilities, so the augmented feature (188) 直接适用。更一般地，如果平滑后的预期路由器权重是) applies directly. More generally, if the smoothed expected router weight is aC2C^{2}的函数function of(X,θ)(X,\theta)在有界集合上，那么它可以包含在on bounded sets, then it can be included inFF完全如 (exactly as in (183) 或 () or (188).

其次，精确的硬路由可以被视为非平滑限制。那么，极限演化就是微分包含，类似于第 1 节中的硬 Mu 子极限。Second, exact hard routing can be treated as a nonsmooth limit. The limiting evolution is then a differential inclusion, analogous to the hard-Muon limit in SectionA.19。在分数相同时，路由器次差分或选择对应关系是设定值的。因此，平滑流收敛证明必须被路由器选择映射的紧凑性和图形收敛参数所取代。. At score ties, the router subdifferential or selection correspondence is set-valued. A smooth-flow convergence proof must therefore be replaced by compactness plus graph-convergence arguments for the router selection map.

(2022)强调稀疏 top-1 路由是不连续的，并且注入的随机噪声可以平滑路由概率。当噪声密度有界时，它们的平滑引理使 Lipschitz 得出路由概率对路由器分数的依赖关系。每当生成的预期门用作以下的门组件时，这种平滑的预期路由器就与当前的希尔伯特值框架兼容emphasizes that sparse top-1 routing is discontinuous and that injected random noise smooths the routing probabilities. Their smoothing lemma gives Lipschitz dependence of the route probabilities on the router scores when the noise density is bounded. Such a smoothed expected router is compatible with the present Hilbert-valued framework whenever the resulting expected gate is used as the gate component ofFF.

结果支持三个结论。首先，正则化算子不仅仅是硬 Muon 的数值扰动：在有限的步长下，它消除了接近平衡的硬极坐标图的非零更新层。其次，在非线性乘积空间问题中，谱 Muon 几何比原始欧几里得动量更有效。三、The results support three conclusions. First, the regularized operator is not merely a numerical perturbation of hard Muon: at finite step size it removes the non-vanishing update floor of the hard polar map near equilibrium. Second, in the nonlinear product-space problem, the spectral Muon geometry is substantially more effective than raw Euclidean momentum. Third,ε\varepsilon具有可解释的作用。大号has an interpretable role. Largeε\varepsilon过度平滑地图；极小over-smooths the map; extremely smallε\varepsilon行为类似于硬介子；中小型behaves like hard Muon; intermediate smallε\varepsilon保留谱加速度，同时仍然允许平滑的哈密顿解释。这些观察结果与理论图景一致，其中preserves the spectral acceleration while still allowing a smooth Hamiltonian interpretation. These observations are consistent with the theoretical picture in whichε>0\varepsilon>0提供平滑镜像图和哈密顿耗散诊断，而硬 Muon 动力学仅恢复为奇异极限。supplies the smooth mirror map and the Hamiltonian dissipation diagnostic, while the hard Muon dynamics are recovered only as a singular limit.

有几个方向仍然开放。最重要的是验证或替换具体变压器体系中的 PL 和上梯度假设。第二个方向是证明秩亏动量下硬 Muon 微分包含的唯一性或选择原理。第三个是分析随机小批量噪声、有限牛顿-舒尔茨近似误差以及自适应选择Several directions remain open.
